en.text: I went swimming in the ocean.

original: 彼は泳ぎたくて海に行った。

en.text: He went to the ocean as he wanted to swim.
He wanted to swim and so travelled to the ocean.

original: 海が見たいな。

en.text: I want to see the sea.

original: 世界遺産でもある宮島の「厳島神社」は、潮が満ちると神社全体がまるで海に浮かんでいるかのように見えます。その姿は神秘的で、世界中から訪れる観光客を魅了し続けています。

en.text: Also known for being a world heritage site, the Itsukushima Shrine in Miyajima gives the impression that it is floating in the ocean whenever the tides come in. Its mystical appearance continues to attract tourists from all over the world.

original: 自宅から海が見えるのよ。

en.text: We can see the ocean from our house.

original: 昨日は海が荒れていた。

en.text: The sea was rough yesterday.

original: ほとんどの人が海の水は飲めないって知ってますよ。

en.text: Most people know sea water isn't drinkable.
Most people know that you can't drink sea water.
Most people know that sea water is undrinkable.

original: その結果、雨が降れば、大量の表土、赤土、化学肥料、農薬が、海に流れだす。

en.text: As a result, when it rains, large amounts of topsoil, clay, chemical fertilizers, and pesticides are washed into the sea.

original: 今日は海がかなり荒れてるよ。

en.text: The sea is pretty rough today.
The sea is quite rough today.

original: 海が見える部屋がいいな。

en.text: I want a room with a sea view.
I'd like a room with a sea view.
I'd like a room with a view of the sea.
I'd like a room that looks out on the sea.

original: みんな揃って海に飛び込んだ。

en.text: Everyone jumped into the ocean together.
Everyone jumped into the sea together.

original: 天の海に雲の波立ち月の船星の林に漕ぎ隠る見ゆ。

en.text: In the heavenly sea, waves of clouds rise; the moon appears as if it were a boat, hidden among the starry groves.

original: 突然海へ飛び込んだ。

en.text: They suddenly dove into the sea.
He suddenly dove into the sea.
She suddenly dove into the sea.
I dove into the sea without warning.
You dove into the sea without warning.

original: 私は海に行く。

en.text: I'm going to the beach.
